title: [review] message.rs:574: RplTarget::write_to panics on
description: write_to computes nbytes = prefix_len.div_ceil(8) and then accesses self.prefix[..nbytes]. If prefix_len > 128, nbytes > 16, but self.prefix is [u8; 16], causing a panic on copy_from_slice. from_bytes validates prefix_len <= 128, but write_to does not, allowing manually constructed RplTarget with invalid prefix_len to crash.
